comment: Mirrors interceptors/exec-wrap/tsconfig.json (NodeNext + strict). Scoped to the reply-filter package. The arbiter is a sibling package; reply-filter declares the narrow arbiter surface it needs structurally (src/arbiter-client.ts) rather than importing the arbiter build, so this package typechecks standalone. Tests use a mock arbiter (unit) and an in-test NDJSON socket server (e2e) and never resolve the real client.
